headline: Qualifier Rodriguez stuns Ross Smith in Wolverhampton
standfirst: Rusty-Jake Rodriguez beat the reigning European champion 5-3, but says he still faces a fight to keep his Tour Card.
body: Rusty-Jake Rodriguez produced the biggest shock of the Grand Slam of Darts' opening night, beating Ross Smith 5-3 in Group O on Saturday.

Rodriguez had needed to win three matches at the qualifier just over a week earlier to reach the tournament. Against Smith, the reigning European champion and World Series Finals winner, he made the most of a poor night on the doubles from his opponent. Smith missed 13 darts at double, and Rodriguez finished the match on tops.

Despite the win, Rodriguez admitted his immediate future is uncertain. Speaking after the match, he said he expects to have to return to Qualifying School to fight for his Tour Card, according to Dartsnews.
For Smith, a two-time major winner, the defeat leaves him needing to respond in his remaining group matches to reach the last 16.
